entry.title: Euclid 2.0.0
entry.summary: # Euclid 2.0.0 Euclidier is now **Euclid**. Same plugin id, so saved projects still find it. ## New - **ALL view** on the LANES tab: FILL, VELOCITY, HUMANIZE and GATE change all eight lanes together, relative to each lane's own value. The circle shows the longest pattern. - **Tap to draw steps** on the circle and on the lane rows. A hand-made pattern is kept and saved with the project until STEPS, FILL or SHIFT change, or you randomise. - **DRUM MODE ALL** gives lanes 1-8 the notes 36-43. - **MI
